summary: Compose varied elevations and routes around a readable hierarchy of landmarks.
objective: Compose varied elevations and routes around a readable hierarchy of landmarks.
example_prompts: Use terrain and landmark rhythm for the scene, preserving its model and user controls.

principles: Let terrain, routes and building purpose influence placement; a grid remains valid when it suits the setting.
Height variation should contribute to navigation or emphasis rather than create arbitrary obstacles.
implementation: Block out major landforms and connected routes before adding small props.
Give important buildings distinct silhouettes, approaches and support transitions.
Frame at least one view where route continuity and vertical relationships are visible together.
observable_checks: An overview communicates how the major places connect.
A close inspection shows roads and foundations meeting the intended terrain or supports.

creative_affordances: Adapt the layout, visual treatment and timing to the task; these are reusable design proposals, not mandatory templates.
known_limits: Authored interaction/presentation guidance; no new scientific claim, accessibility certification or runtime verification is asserted.
